objective_success_bonus: If both legs contact ground and |x| < 0.1 and |y| < 0.1 and |vy| < 0.5 and |angle| < 0.1: +200
main_engine_bonus: If distance < 0.5 and not already claimed: +10 (one-time bonus, tracked via self.main_engine_bonus_claimed)
progress_bonus: If distance < prev_distance: +0.1 * (prev_distance - distance) (continuous feedback for descending)
descent_reward: If m_power > 0 and vy < 0: +0.5 * (prev_vy - vy) where prev_vy is the previous vertical velocity (stored in self.last_vy)
hovering_penalty: If |vy| < 0.1 and distance >= previous_distance: -1.5 (penalty for hovering without progress)
diagnostics: distance, vy, leg_contact, angle, angular_velocity, m_power, s_power, crash, main_engine_bonus, progress_bonus, descent_reward, hovering_penalty, prev_distance
